sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the testing procedures P1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

There are eight burners 
per unit manufactured by Forney Company. The major parts of each burner are 
(solenoid valve, limit switch and spark system). They are installed on the 
movable parts of the burner such as oil gun, igniter gun, fuel valve and air 
register.

They are 
used for moving these parts from closed position to opened position and vice 
versa and for giving the indication of these parts .In addition to that, the 
Spark Rod is used for igniting the light fuel with a High Voltage Electric spark 
for starting a Burning Operation.

The first draft initiated by eng. Islam Sabry on
18 
April 2004, submitted by eng. Ibrahim Hefny on 
24
April 2004, reviewed by EDEPC
Quality Control eng. Abdel Menem Al Emam, accepted by General Director eng. 
Hamdy
Azab and approved by eng. Mokhtar Abdel Latef Head Sector of Abu Sultan Power
Plant.

Safety Precaution

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable 
ID safety category.

Safety
fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

ارتداء معدات السلامة والصحية مثل خوذة السلامة، 
أحذية السلامة... الخ.
The boiler must be off.
Close manual isolating valves for all main fuel.
Disconnect power supply.

sections.text: Testing Procedure (solenoid valve)

Connect solenoid terminal to 110 AC Voltage 
 external power supply.
Turn On the Power Supply Switch.
Check the Air output from the Solenoid.

If there is Air output equal to the supplied 
 Air then the Solenoid is OK.

If not, you have two estimated problems.
الأول 
 is the damage of the solenoid coil and you can measure it's resistance with 
 the Multimeter-if it is bad you must replace it with a new coil.
The second 
 is of the Solenoid parts (O rings, vent strainer & Spool).

If the problem still exists, you have to 
 replace all the solenoid with a new one.

sections.text:
Testing 
Procedure (Spark System)
Retract out the rod of the Spark

Connect Transformer Terminals to 110 AC Voltage 
 External Power supply.
Turn On the Power Supply Switch.
Check the generated Spark and note its color.

If the 
 generated Spark appeared good, then the Spark System is OK.
If not, you have two estimated Procedures.

ال أولاً is to clean the rod and its 
 head.

ال ثانية is to replace all Spark with 
 a new one.

sections.text: Return Solenoid Valve and Spark System to Service

Return solenoid valve and spark system to 
 service by disconnecting it from the 110 AC voltage power supply.
Reconnect the wires to the cabinet termination.
Connect main power.
Open manual isolating valves.

Place a copy of test result in the field 
 maintenance file.

Repeat all the previous steps for all other 
 Burners.
